title: ఆత్మగౌరవ భవనాలపై చీకటి జీవో
description: ‘బీసీలపై వ్యతిరేకతతోనే ఆత్మగౌరవ భవనాలపై కాంగ్రెస్‌ ప్రభుత్వం చీకటి జీవో-14 తెచ్చింది. ఆ భవనాలపై సర్కార్‌ పెత్తనం చేసేందుకు కుట్రలు చేస్తున్నది’ అని శాసనమండలిలో ప్రతిపక్ష నేత మధుసూదనాచారి ధ్వజమెత్తారు. గురువారం తెలంగాణ భవన్‌లో బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ ఎమ్మెల్యేలు, ఎమ్మెల్సీలతో కలిసి ఆయన మీడియాతో మాట్లాడారు. బీసీ సంక్షేమ శాఖ నుంచే ఈ చీకటి జీవో రావడం, ఆ శాఖ మంత్రి అయిన బీసీ బిడ్డ పొన్నం మౌనం వహించడం దుర్మార్గమని ఖండించారు.

title: యువత ఆవిష్కరణకు రెక్కలు తొడిగిన టీహబ్‌!
description: ‘కలలకు రెకలు తొడగడం’ అనే నినాదానికి టీ హబ్‌ నిలువెత్తు నిదర్శనమని బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ వరింగ్‌ ప్రెసిడెంట్‌ కేటీఆర్‌ పేర్కొన్నారు. ఆవిషరణలు, సాంకేతిక పరిజ్ఞానం, నూతన ఆలోచనలకు కేంద్రంగా హైదరాబాద్‌ను ప్రపంచస్థాయి గమ్యస్థానంగా తీర్చిదిద్దాలనే దూరదృష్టితో కేసీఆర్‌ హయాంలో టీహబ్‌ను ఏర్పాటు చేసినట్టు గుర్తుచేశారు. 11 ఏండ్ల ప్రస్థానంలో వేలాది మంది యువ ఔత్సాహిక పారిశ్రామికవేత్తలకు అండగా నిలిచి, వారి ఆలోచనలను విజయవంతమైన స్టార్టప్‌లుగా మార్చేందుకు ఈ సంస్థ విశేషంగా కృషి చేసిందని ప్రశంసించారు.

title: అన్నీ పార్టీల చూపు గులాబీ వైపు

title: JP Morgan to add Philippines and Saudi Arabia to key EM bond index over 10 months
description: JP Morgan has announced plans to include Saudi Arabia and the Philippines in its emerging market debt index starting in 2027. The Saudi riyal-denominated sukuk and Philippine peso-denominated government bonds will be integrated over a ten-month period. The index is expected to adjust the maximum country weight limit from 10% to 9%. Saudi Arabia's weight will reach 2.71%, while the Philippines will have a weight of 1.64%.

title: The average US 30-year mortgage rate falls to 7.18% this week, its third straight decline
description: The average long-term mortgage rates in the U.S. decreased for the third consecutive week, offering some respite. The average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage declined to 7.18% from 7.24%, according to Freddie Mac. Additionally, the 15-year fixed-rate mortgages saw a drop to 6.57%, slightly down from last week. These lower rates help to alleviate the financial burden on prospective homebuyers facing increased costs.

title: US yields fall in choppy session as oil rises and equities sink
description: As geopolitical tensions change the landscape, US Treasuries are witnessing a spike in demand while equity markets take a hit and oil prices show volatility. Investors are reassessing their outlook on the US-Iran relations following new election results. The labor market remains resilient with dropping unemployment claims and heightened productivity levels, pointing towards ongoing inflation risk.

title: Paras Healthcare posts Rs 40 crore Q2 net profit in first results after listing
description: Paras Healthcare announced a profit after tax of Rs 40.35 crore in the September quarter. This performance shows a significant increase from the net profit of Rs 12.38 crore reported last year. Revenue from operations reached Rs 510.89 crore, with expenses at Rs 463.12 crore during the same period. The company utilized a portion of its IPO proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet.

title: Godfrey Phillips Q2 profit down 37% to Rs 190 cr; revenue up twofold at Rs 4,198 cr
description: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd reported a significant 37.73 percent decrease in net profit for the September quarter, primarily driven by a substantial tax increase from the previous fiscal year. Despite this, the company's total consolidated income surged to Rs 8,139.64 crore during the first half of FY27. To counteract the volumetric impact from rising taxes, a tactical pricing strategy was implemented.

title: Apple seeks about $7 billion from bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
description: Apple is seeking about $7 billion from a US-dollar bond offering, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. The iPhone maker is the latest major tech company to tap debt markets as the sector raises large sums to fund AI expansion.

title: Qualcomm shares slump 9% as weak smartphone chip sales overshadow data-center momentum
description: Qualcomm's shares dropped significantly in early trading following disappointing smartphone chip sales. The company's largest business segment faced a 26% revenue decline, leading to lower overall chip sales. While Qualcomm's investments in data-center and automotive chips strengthen its growth potential, analysts remain skeptical about immediate earnings. Brokerages have reduced their price targets on Qualcomm's stock after recent results were released.

title: Elon Musk gambled $445 million to boost Republicans in midterms and came up short
description: Elon Musk's hefty USD 445 million investment in Republican candidates did not yield the desired electoral success, as Republicans faced significant losses, ceding control of Congress. This setback has prompted Democrats to contemplate investigating Musk's business operations. Critics have denounced his financial influence in politics, highlighting the risks of affluent individuals shaping policy. Anticipated changes in Texas's Democratic leadership suggest intensified scrutiny of Musk's ties to

title: Emerging markets lose $33.8 billion in October as investors flee Asian stocks
description: October witnessed an alarming withdrawal of $33.8 billion by foreign investors from emerging markets, the largest since March. Almost all of this outflow consisted of equities, severely impacting Taiwan. While Emerging Asia grappled with major losses, Latin America encountered minimal setbacks amid election related volatility. Additionally, Chinese stocks continued to see foreign sell offs for the fifth consecutive month.

title: Nasdaq tumbles over 3% as tech stocks extend selloff after Democrats sweep midterms; Tesla plunges 9%, chipmakers slide
description: US stocks faced a sharp decline on Thursday, particularly in technology shares, amid concerns over regulatory scrutiny. The Nasdaq Composite fell over 3%, reversing optimism following the Democrats' midterm election victories. Key companies including Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices, and Tesla were among the hardest hit. Investors expressed worries about the implications of stronger Democratic control on the artificial intelligence industry.
